evidence.notes: Takes a direct object (remercier quelqu'un); the reason is introduced by the preposition de/pour, so it is not a second object.
Direct-object construction in all listed senses: renverser un verre (knock over), renverser un régime (overthrow).
Takes a direct object, as the usage note states: résoudre un problème, une équation (to solve/resolve).
Pronominal verb constructed with à (s'abonner à un service), per the usage note; no direct object.
Pronominal -ir verb meaning to crouch or squat, used without a direct object (elle s'accroupit).
